name: io.github.tonyyang0504/google_merchant-mcp
description: Google Merchant Center (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing. Every tool maps to a d

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID of your Google Cloud project (with the Merchant API enabled and the project registered with the Merchant Center account).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret of the same client.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from a one-time consent with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content by a user of the Merchant Center account; the runtime mints access tokens at https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_DATA_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: API product data source to write to, in the form accounts/<account>/dataSources/<id> (Merchant Center > Data sources, or the Data Sources API); only API data sources can be edited.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CONTENT_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter content language of your products, e.g. en; part of the product input id <language>~<feedLabel>~<offerId>.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_FEED_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Feed label of your products, e.g. US; part of the product input id.
